description: This file implements a noise suppression filter for audio streams using PicoVoice's Koala engine within the Pipecat framework. It defines the KoalaFilter class that manages noise reduction in real-time, handling audio buffering, engine initialization, and filter control via start, stop, and process_frame methods.

classes.name: KoalaFilter
classes.description: A class implementing real-time noise suppression for audio streams using PicoVoice's Koala engine. It buffers audio data to match engine requirements and provides control over filtering state.

methods.name: None __init__(self, *, access_key: str)
methods.description: Initializes the KoalaFilter with an access key for the PicoVoice engine and sets initial state flags.

methods.name: start(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Configures the filter with the input sample rate, warning if it does not match the Koala engine's expected rate.

methods.name: stop(self)
methods.description: Resets the Koala engine, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: process_frame(self, frame: FilterControlFrame)
methods.description: Processes control frames to enable or disable the filter dynamically.

methods.name: bytes filter(self, audio: bytes)
methods.description: Applies noise suppression to incoming audio data, buffering as necessary and processing in chunks.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, audio: bytes) -> bytes:$/
